label: L di/dt noise
subgoals: Estimate the current change and the time over which it happens
Multiply the inductance by the current slope
Express nanohenries times milliamperes per nanosecond in millivolts

label: Simultaneous switching through shared pins
subgoals: Divide the pin inductance by the number of parallel pins
Multiply the per-driver current slope by the number of drivers
Multiply the two to estimate the bounce

label: Decoupling charge
subgoals: Compute the charge as the extra current times its duration
Divide the charge by the allowed droop
Express milliamperes times nanoseconds per millivolt in nanofarads
